tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search every page of agent-manager.dev by title, description and section. Returns page summaries with the slug get_doc_page takes. Use this first when you do not already know which page answers the question.

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.description: Return one page of agent-manager.dev as Markdown, with the site chrome removed. The slug comes from search_docs or get_reference and may contain slashes.

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Return one reference list about agent-manager. topic "pages" lists every page on agent-manager.dev; "agents" lists the coding CLIs it manages, with the command each runs and where its live status comes from (answer "does agent-manager support X" with this); "mcp_tools" lists the tools the agent-mana

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
